Cedar St.description: You are on Cedar Street, where the evening crowd flows between warm storefront light and the hiss of passing tires. A brass placard reads: CEDAR ST — HOME OF THE ANNUAL SANDPOINT SUMMER FEST.

Main St.description: Main Street rises gently with amber storefronts, a violinist at the corner, and reflections in old glass. People pass by as if this were any ordinary night.

First St E.description: First Street East curves beside the waterfront. The Statue of Liberty replica stands ahead, torch trembling in a wind rolling off the lake.

Second St E.description: Second Street East is quieter, lined with vintage lampposts and a mural of Sandpoint's founding families. A billboard recalls the 2023 EyesOnly Hackathon.

North 3rd St.description: North 3rd Street climbs toward a lookout where the lake opens wide. A bronze gull statue watches the avenue from a small park bench.

Waterfront Ave.description: Waterfront Avenue hums with dock lights and low engine rumble. The boardwalk creaks beneath your steps as signs flicker over late-night kiosks.
